translation: Raw it is warm, cooked it is cold, greatly toxic. It governs amenorrhea in women (女子月閉), rotting the fetus (爛胎), metal-wound pus and blood (金創膿血), is not beneficial to the male genitals (不利丈夫陰), and kills the poison of blister beetles (斑蝥毒). It may be refined; it benefits the blood vessels, makes one's complexion good, and its transformations communicate with ghosts and spirits.
